summary: Two current-build validateOnly inputs and one focused coverage-accounting suite behaved as expected. A predeclared seven-day dispatch slice, a bounded P-008 test-rerun slice, a seven-defect sample, and five plan-item promotion-to-completion intervals were measured. The twelve-file P-008 matrix passed on the current local candidate, with one named test path uncommitted; this is not a reproducible committed-candidate verdict. Current rev4 adequacy still fails R-10 and separate-delivery certification. The populations are not comparable to the frozen P-001 baseline, so no causal efficiency improvement or no-sprawl verdict is asserted. Deployed-only certification remains unmeasured by this artifact.

currentUnfinishedItemAge.writer: work_items:get projects WI-10000985 createdAt and open state; plans:get lifecycle.freshness.now supplies the read timestamp
currentUnfinishedItemAge.scopeLimit: This measures the unfinished promoted work item, including queue, dependency, idle and active time. It is not an acceptance-wait-only measure, a P-001 matched plan cohort or a productivity verdict.

currentAdequacyDiagnostic.writer: plans:evaluate-spec-test-adequacy grades exact current clause revisions and bound work-item evidence; this workItemIds-pinned read is diagnostic, not the unscoped plan ship verdict
currentAdequacyDiagnostic.scopeLimit: A successful tool read is not acceptance: the operational proof discloses incomplete cohorts and is source-stale; final delivery identity is still absent. The governing ship gate evaluates all bindings without this work-item filter.

completionDispatch.writer: packages/operator-core/lib/projected-tool-deps.ts: telemetry row construction and batched tool_invocations INSERT; packages/operator-core/lib/telemetry-call-origin.ts: agent-origin classification
completionDispatch.interpretation: Status and error-message buckets are dispatcher telemetry, not adjudicated false rejections. Replayed means the tool did not rerun. The latency measures individual dispatch settlement, not elapsed plan time.

otherDeclaredToolCalls.interpretation: Counts share the completionDispatch window and agent-origin filter. They are mechanical submissions, not successful workflow totals.

liveLedgerRetention.positiveControl: A Papercusp work_items:complete row on September 26 was returned from the same tool_invocations table and scope.

historicalBaseline.limitation: The historical September 2-9 tool-invocation rows are outside the configured 14-day retention window. The frozen snapshot preserves reported aggregates but cannot be rerun against the live ledger; window lengths, serving builds and cohort populations differ, so no same-instrument improvement percentage follows.

coverageAccountingTest.scopeLimit: The router stamped only the named test path; this does not prove the full imported source graph remained unchanged.

p008MatrixRerunSlice.writer: packages/operator-core/test/reporters/admin-test-runs-reporter.ts: per-file harness_shared.test_runs rows; packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/testing/runs.ts: runGroup rollup uses the latest verdict per file
p008MatrixRerunSlice.population: The exact same twelve P-008 Vitest file paths in the September 26 local matrix and September 27 admin-ui run group; no other tests or reruns included
p008MatrixRerunSlice.rerunReason: The acceptance rubric changed to revision 4 and prior matrix proof became stale; the later run tested the new candidate rather than repeating an unchanged verdict. The three failures are recorded by rows 19682919-19682921 and cannot be counted as passing acceptance.
p008MatrixRerunSlice.scopeLimit: This is one observed matrix rerun, not a census of all P-008 or P-001 reruns. Both sets of rows have worktreeDirty=true, and the two candidate SHAs differ; no elapsed acceptance wait or saved cost follows from file execution counts.

p008CurrentLocalMatrix.provenance: npm run test:file stamped the twelve named paths before and after the run at the same HEAD; spec-test-adequacy.test.ts had uncommitted +22/-0 and eleven named paths were clean. All twelve durable testing:runs rows passed, but worktreeDirty=true on the rows reflects the shared tree. Imports outside the named paths were not fingerprinted.
p008CurrentLocalMatrix.scopeLimit: This proves the current local candidate passed the matrix. It does not prove the committed HEAD alone passes, resolve the rev4 R-10 or separate-delivery adequacy gaps, or certify a deployed release.

knownDefectSample.writer: work_items:get detail projects each work item's current state and lifecycle.reopenHistory; lifecycle.coverage states that non-terminal transitions are not recorded
knownDefectSample.population: The seven exact defect IDs listed in docs/evidence/review-verification-efficiency-p008-measurement-2026-09-13.json; no discovery of other defects is implied
knownDefectSample.scopeLimit: Current done state does not establish that a defect never escaped or later recurred. The one recorded reopen was from resolved/watchdog-auto-close, and the work-item lifecycle explicitly omits non-terminal transitions. This named sample is not the full declared-workflow defect census.

planItemPromotionToCompletion.writer: packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/work_items/get-shape.ts projects createdAt and closedAt; burn_down.ts uses closedAt for terminal transitions rather than updatedAt; completionAuthority=committed is read from each work item
planItemPromotionToCompletion.population: The five exact plan-promotion work-items WI-10000980 through WI-10000984, corresponding to P-003 through P-007; all are currently done with committed completion authority
planItemPromotionToCompletion.calculation: (closedAt - createdAt) in hours for each named work item, then median of five; source timestamps are available from work_items:get
planItemPromotionToCompletion.scopeLimit: Creation happened at plan promotion for all five items. The interval includes queueing, dependencies, idle time, implementation and review; takenAt is null on all five, so this cannot be interpreted as claim-to-acceptance time or exclusive engineering effort. No matching P-001 cohort was measured.
